measurement_status: structural counts only; current-source measured numbers must be supplied by the parent
scope: Frozen driver controls, branch-dependent operation counts, pool scheduling, diagnostics and finalization. No mathematics, grid, cap, algorithm or admission change.

frozen_constants.selection_policy: Not forced. Sort stable-positive scout dimensions and screen the first two.
frozen_constants.cache_policy_for_model: Fresh independent caches for two qualification executions; no hits assumed. The standalone preflight bypasses caching entirely.

scout_cost.scheduling: Eight resolution jobs in one bounded three-worker pool. Each job handles the full grid; it is not 224 independently scheduled jobs. Retained results are materialized in resolution order after completion observation.
scout_cost.makespan_note: Use measured whole-pool wall time or the actual three-worker job schedule. sum(S)/3 is not an upper bound. max(max(S),sum(S)/3) is only an ideal-work lower bound; sum(S) is a serial-work envelope before lifecycle and parent overhead.

rigorous_screen_cost.screen_calls_per_dimension: 2 through 4 on a stable positive return; 4 when ladder exhausts without a stable positive. An all-assembly-failed ladder raises after all four attempts.
rigorous_screen_cost.midpoint_eigendiagnostic_calls_per_compl: 1 for A, plus 4 for schur/GV/GP/GR when mu is certified positive; diagnostics may report unavailable
rigorous_screen_cost.ordering: Each dimension's precision ladder is sequential inside a worker. The two dimension jobs can overlap. Both screening jobs finish before any exact candidate construction starts.
rigorous_screen_cost.positive_early_return: Requires previous usable precision, stable midpoint change, stable signs, reduced widths, and positive complement, finite-block and Schur midpoint values. First possible selected precision is 256, not 128.
rigorous_screen_cost.negative_return: MATHEMATICAL_NEGATIVE is decided only after ladder exhaustion from the final two attempts, with stable negative Schur midpoint, positive complement and finite block, stable signs and reduced widths. A negative 128/256 pair does not stop the loop early.
rigorous_screen_cost.precision_limit_return: Insufficient diagnostic stability or sign/width conditions at exhaustion returns precision_limit_reached, not a positive candidate.
rigorous_screen_cost.R_definition: A[n,p] + screen exact width/scalar diagnostics + midpoint eigendiagnostics + precision-pair/classification work, with cache/IPC costs added separately. Do not substitute raw assembly timing for R.

candidate_retry_cost.ordering: Construct candidates sequentially for every rigorous survivor before confirming any ready candidate. A ready primary does not skip construction of a surviving fallback.
candidate_retry_cost.termination: Return at the first all_margins_positive attempt for that dimension; otherwise consume all 16 combinations, including retries after rounding or witness failures.
candidate_retry_cost.assembly_reuse: None with no cache or a fresh cache. Every bit combination calls run_candidate and reassembles at the same selected Arb precision. The preceding rigorous screen is a different cache kind and is not reused.
candidate_retry_cost.failure_path_note: Later counts are conditional. Even-witness failure skips odd-witness construction. Rounding failure skips all witness work. Audit matrices are serialized before witness work, so witness failures still incur this input-serialization cost.
candidate_retry_cost.witness_work_per_parity: Exact midpoint LDL, exact lower-triangular inverse, dyadic witness rounding, two dense exact interval matrix products for congruence, then Gershgorin. LDL failure skips inverse, congruence and Gershgorin.
candidate_retry_cost.congruence_operation_count_formula: 2*(ceil(N/2)^3 + floor(N/2)^3) interval multiply-accumulates. This is an operation count, not a time estimate; rational numerator/denominator sizes affect cost.
candidate_retry_cost.K_definition: Full real candidate call, including new assembly, exact diagnostics/rounding/Schur, full or partial parity witnesses, audit-input construction and successful witness serialization. Nested inclusive stage timings are not additive.

confirmation_cost.rigorous_cap_does_not_cap_confirmation: The rigorous ladder ends at 512. Confirmation computes base_precision + 128*step_index, so 640 and 768 are in scope when the base is 512.
confirmation_cost.fixed_input_policy: Hold support, dimension, residual order and selected matrix/witness bits fixed. Each higher precision reassembles through run_candidate. comparison_prec is not passed.
confirmation_cost.return_rules: Stop this helper on first qualified pair. Continue after CandidateStageError and use the last completed attempt for later pairs; a skipped failed step may therefore produce a nonadjacent pair. Unclassified candidate exceptions return CANDIDATE_CHECK_FAILED immediately. The driver confirms ready dimensions sequentially and returns on the first qualified dimension.
confirmation_cost.qualification_conditions: Strictly positive exact margins, stable signs and relative changes <=1/1000, nonincreasing working matrix/scalar widths, nonincreasing rounded matrix widths, and successful exact rounding at both compared precisions. Width predicates permit equality.

variables.G: actual screened dimensions, at most two
variables.L_n: screen calls executed for dimension n, at most four
variables.V: rigorous survivors, a subset of G
variables.C_n: candidate bit combinations executed for n in V, from one to sixteen
variables.Q: ready dimensions actually confirmed, at most two
variables.H_n: higher precision steps executed for n in Q, from one to two
variables.P_n: higher confirmation attempts completed with positive margins for a ready dimension, at most H_n

path_conditional_counts_and_formulas.exact_uncached_assembly_count: sum_G L_n + sum_V C_n + sum_Q H_n

real_negative_branch.condition: Scout selects 192/196 and both full rigorous ladders exhaust with mathematical_negative, or otherwise no survivor. Classification must come from actual screens, not be assigned in advance.
real_negative_branch.formula: T_negative = startup/provenance + scout_pool_cost + rigorous_pool_cost + fresh_cache_cost_for_screen_results + live_observability + freeze/hash + negative_bundle_publication + terminal_rendering
real_negative_branch.engineering_interpretation: A valid sufficient-Schur rejection is a complete tooling result. It is not a positive frozen candidate and does not decide the full mathematical problem.

conservative_all_branches_operation_enve.formula: T_envelope = startup/provenance + scout_pool_cost + full_rigorous_pool_cost + sum_n sum_16_pairs K[n,p_n,m,w] + sum_n sum_i=1..2 K[n,p_n+128*i,m_n,w_n] + all_precision_pair_diagnostics + fresh_cache_key/write_cost + live_observability + freeze/hash + native_bundle_audits + bundle_publication + terminal_rendering
conservative_all_branches_operation_enve.interpretation: A conservative operation envelope, not a measured wall-time upper bound. Per-stage maxima need not all occur on one execution because readiness, exceptions and early returns exclude some paths. Failed-candidate timing cannot supply an upper bound for successful K. No division of sequential candidate/confirmation work by rigorous_workers is valid.

path_conditional_counts_and_formulas.two_fresh_qualification_executions: Two independent repetitions of the actual conditional path with separate caches, plus byte audits, canonical comparison and an OS process scan. Do not count preflight as either qualification execution. No timings are inferred here.

startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.startup: Interpreter/imports, source/provenance hashing, parent validation and output lock/live identity startup. Spawn imports and IPC overlap work and cannot be inferred from ProcessPoolExecutor construction time alone.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.fresh_cache: Each _cached_result invocation with a real cache hashes CACHE_SOURCE_PATHS for its key and attempts a disk read. Successful producer results are serialized to a temporary file and atomically replaced. Producer exceptions are not cached. Screen and candidate keys differ, so screens do not eliminate candidate assembly. With cache_dir=None the producer is called immediately, with no key hashing/read/write.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.cache_note: Only applies to integrated fresh-cache workflow, not the uncached preflight. Successful writes are conditional and less than or equal to call count.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.worker_serialization: Spawn argument/result pickling, result delivery and parent validation. Candidate and confirmation calls are parent-sequential, not pooled. Full exact rational diagnostic strings can be large.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.diagnostic_costs: Screen matrix widths and up to five midpoint spectral diagnostics; candidate six working matrix width reports, three scalar widths, active-term exact enclosures, four rounded matrix widths, audit inputs and precision-pair checks. Assembly-only benchmarks omit most of these.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.live_observability: Bounded live payloads, fsynced events, atomic status updates, periodic heartbeats and stderr flushes. Number of heartbeats depends on measured duration, not a fixed stage count.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.freeze: Two _freeze_result_payload JSON encode/decode/hash passes in CLI success path, plus bundle result-digest validation. Large candidate/audit payloads are copied and encoded; count separately from numerical work.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.bundle_native_replay: Before publication, _multi_prime_candidate_audits calls audit_candidate_inputs on every positive attempt. The base is normally present once in candidate attempts and once in confirmation attempts, so it is replayed twice even though its output artifact is deduplicated. Replay reconstructs exact Schur and performs two-parity native fmpq midpoint/radius congruences; this is computation, not just JSON I/O or theorem admission.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.bundle_native_replay_call_formula: sum_ready_candidates(2 + number_of_completed_positive_higher_attempts) for normal complete confirmation records; at most 8 for two ready dimensions and two completed higher steps each
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.bundle_atomic_write_count_formula: len(scout_runs) + sum_screen_attempts + count(candidate_stability_reports) + len(rigorous_failures) + count(unique_positive_exact_audits) + 3, where 3 is candidate.json, summary.json and run-manifest.json
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.bundle_write_note: Counts exclude .live, .run.lock and caches. Failure artifacts can replace/augment attempted-result accounting according to the actual retained result; do not silently use 27 for every failure path.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.publication: Established JSON allow_nan=False serialization, byte SHA-256, file flush/fsync, retrying atomic replace, POSIX directory fsync and manifest-last publication. No exact-data fallback stringification.
startup_cache_serialization_diagnostics_.cleanup: Normal pool shutdown, then owned-process verification. Conditional post-shutdown join/terminate/kill waits use 0.5/1.0/1.0 seconds per recovery join, not fixed normal-run charges. Standalone global active-child count is separate from verifier's owned-worker proof. No unrelated process termination.

current_source_outcome_evidence_not_stag.limitation: Diagnostic runner reused its assembly. This is not a run_candidate reassembly timing and contains no stage cost measurement.

current_source_outcome_evidence_not_stag.observation: Strict negative upper Rayleigh values at both dimensions and 384/512, including exact rounded Schur at 384

failure_measurement_interpretation.can_inform: Measured assembly/rounding/Schur and partial even-LDL costs on their exact source snapshot and inputs. A late LDL failure exercises most of that parity's LDL prefix. New phase11 failed-candidate measurements can replace stale numbers for matching current-source paths.
failure_measurement_interpretation.cannot_bound_successful_two_parity_cost: Every cited LDL failure exits before triangular inverse, witness rounding, exact congruence and Gershgorin, and skips the odd parity entirely. Their total time is not an upper bound for a successful candidate, confirmation helper or bundle replay. It is not a portable lower bound on a different successful input either, because arithmetic sizes and conditioning differ.
failure_measurement_interpretation.other_failure_kinds: An even Gershgorin failure exercises one complete even congruence but still skips odd; an odd LDL failure includes an even success but omits odd inverse/congruence; an odd Gershgorin failure exercises both parity congruences on that input but does not establish an upper time bound on another successful input. Rounding failure bounds no congruence work.
failure_measurement_interpretation.profiling_caveat: profile_multi_prime_workflow._candidate_sample records inclusive nested stage times, sets result=None on CandidateStageError and computes native widths after its timing boundary. Those rows do not retain failed audit_inputs or measure successful bundle native replay.

standalone_runner_contract.screens: Actual _rigorous_screen_worker, support 11/20, dimensions 192 and 196, precision ladder 128/256/384/512, residual order32, cache=None, one bounded two-worker verified spawn pool. Full attempts and exact diagnostics retained. No scout selection or integrated driver.
standalone_runner_contract.controls: Two separate fresh T=2/5,N40 base candidates at 64/32 bits, residual32: base512 with one 128-bit helper step to640; separate base640 with one step to768. actual qualified outcome retained without asserting positivity or assigning a frozen target.
standalone_runner_contract.audit_outputs: Separate base/confirmation audit-input JSON per control when the production APIs provide inputs; exact interval/witness serializers are called by run_candidate itself, then established atomic JSON publication is used.
standalone_runner_contract.timing: Whole screen ladders, individual actual screen calls, verified lifecycle, base construction, confirmation helper, every actual candidate call, nested exact stages, publications and parent/worker CPU. Import clocks exclude interpreter launch; IPC startup is not claimed isolated.
standalone_runner_contract.prerequisites: Locked repository Python environment with python-flint/numpy/scipy and readable Git/source files; original artifact location for root resolution; unused output filenames. No additional mathematics or positive frozen witness is required.
source_limitations: The control is one-prime overlap, not a successful two-prime 192/196 candidate, so its time cannot upper-bound successful frozen congruence cost.
Each control deliberately requests one helper step; frozen extra_steps=2 remains unchanged in production and in the cost model.
The driver catches per-precision assembly exceptions and may continue; the runner records full actual ladder results and actual classification, not an invented status.
Early rounding CandidateStageError may expose no audit_inputs; retain its real error, never manufacture proof inputs.
The runner does not seal a bundle, independently replay candidates, admit a theorem, run a scout or execute phase12.
Only owned-pool verification and Python active_children are recorded by the runner; the parent must perform the requested independent OS process scan.

unmeasured_uncertainties: Current-source phase11 component and whole-pool wall/CPU measurements; all timings in this structural model remain null.
Successful two-parity rational inverse/congruence/Gershgorin at frozen two-prime dimensions. No positive frozen target is required for tooling acceptance.
Data-dependent exact rational growth and hardware/load variation prevent a wall-time upper bound from finite branch counts alone.
Successful bundle native exact replay, including duplicate base replay, and large exact JSON publication.
Fresh-cache source hashing/serialization overhead in an integrated run versus the no-cache preflight.
Spawn imports, IPC, live status heartbeat count, shutdown recovery, peak aggregate memory and independent OS process inventory.
Actual scout selection and precise terminal classification must remain unforced. Historical negative evidence does not replace an actual ordered current-source screen ladder.
